objective: Find the best-supported way to keep an MIT LICENSE copyright year current.
scope: Authoritative sources on copyright notice years (US Copyright Office, Berne/UK guidance, OSI/SPDX/REUSE, major projects' practice) and maintained GitHub Actions or approaches that update the year on January 1.
constraints: Separate sourced facts from inference; cite every claim.
acceptance_criteria: States whether the notice year must or should change yearly and what major projects do (start year, range, or no year).

Compares concrete automation options (scheduled GitHub Actions workflow on 1 January UTC opening a PR, specific maintained actions with versions and pinning, a CI check that fails on a stale year, avoiding the need) with trade-offs, and recommends one for a small Bun/TypeScript repo whose CI pins actions by commit SHA and whose contributing rules forbid new overlapping tools.
result: Recommend filling the Apache appendix line once with Copyright 2026 David Basile Filho (first-publication year), no NOTICE, no automation; optional rolling-year via scheduled PR workflow or FantasticFiasco/action-update-license-year v3 (node20, token needs). Several primary pages unreachable; excerpts flagged.

acceptance.rationale: Research checked: first publication confirmed 2026-10-13 from repo history; sources cited with excerpts flagged.
